description: Standalone pagination controls element targeting any [data-paged] container. The element form of the data-paged primitive — same shape as the layout-grid / data-layout-* element-attribute symmetry across VB. Authors pick the surface that fits the markup; both feed the same engine. Multiple <pager-wc> instances pointing at the same target stay in sync via paged:change; a target inserted later is picked up.

attributes.name: target
attributes.description: CSS selector for the [data-paged] container (preferred form). Only an element carrying data-paged counts; resolution is retried when a paged:change fires and on click.

attributes.name: for
attributes.description: ID of the target container (HTML-form-style alternative to target).

attributes.name: data-style
attributes.description: Control style. load-more needs a progressive target (data-paged-style="load-more" on the container, plus data-paged-controls="none" to drop its own button). Infinite is intentionally unsupported — a sentinel pattern doesn't make sense for decoupled controls.

attributes.name: data-label-nav
attributes.description: Accessible name of the rendered <nav> landmark. Give top and bottom pagers distinct names.

attributes.name: data-label-page
attributes.description: Accessible name of each page-number button; {page} is the number.

attributes.name: data-label-status
attributes.description: prev-next status text (polite live region); {page} and {total}.

attributes.name: data-label-load-more
attributes.description: Load-more button text; {n} is the number of items still hidden.

attributes.name: data-label-no-more
attributes.description: Load-more button text once every item is shown.

attributes.name: data-label-missing
attributes.description: Visible note rendered while no [data-paged] target resolves (not a live region).

events.name: pager-wc:navigate
events.description: Bubbles from the pager before it dispatches paged:goto on the target. Fired for page navigations only (numbered / prev-next), not for load-more. Not cancelable. Use for analytics / scroll-restore hooks; listen for paged:change on the target for after-navigation work.
